name: Helmlab
description: We present Helmlab, a family of two purpose-built color spaces for UI design systems sharing a common 11-stage analytical structure: MetricSpace, a 72-parameter space optimized for color-difference prediction, and GenSpace, a 44-parameter space optimized for gradient and palette generation. The forward transform maps CIE XYZ to a perceptually-organized Lab representation through learned matrices, per-channel power compression, Fourier hue correction, and embedded Helmholtz-Kohlrausch lightness adjustment.
